name: Morinaga Rika
source:
Likes: Cute ribbons, collecting cute stickers, baths, donuts
Dislikes: Greasy and spicy foods (In reality, loves them)

A beautiful girl who is a member of the idol group "Lovematic" who transfers into [url=/c48319]Kazuya's[/url] class. She transferred into Kureha Gakuen - which is currently a hot topic due to its mixed outdoors baths - in order to make a TV special about it, and gain more popularity. Though she seems sweet, her true nature is more blunt and darker; it easily comes out when Rika is fighting with someone.
